text: The DeepSeek AI mobile app. Andrey Rudakov / Bloomberg via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 29, 2026, 6:00 PM EDT By Kevin Collier Chinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike , in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.
